homeBuyer.title: Home dashboard
homeBuyer.intro: Your starting screen — today's meetings and to-dos at a glance.
steps: Check upcoming, sent, received, and completed counts in Meeting status. Tap a number to open Meetings.
Review time, counterpart, and venue in Today's schedule, and tap an item for details.
If you have received requests, respond by accepting or declining in Meetings.
Check the latest updates in the Notifications card, or tap View all to open your inbox.
tips: Use the left sidebar to move between Discover, Meetings, and Profile.

homeExhibitor.title: Home dashboard
homeExhibitor.intro: Your exhibitor starting screen — received meeting requests and today's schedule.
steps: Check upcoming, sent, received, and completed counts in Meeting status. Tap a number to open Meetings.
Respond to received requests by accepting or declining in Meetings.
Review time, counterpart, and booth location in Today's schedule.
Check the latest updates in the Notifications card, or tap View all to open your inbox.
tips: To be visible to buyers, your profile and application must be fully approved.

discoverBuyer.title: Discover companies
discoverBuyer.intro: Browse participating companies and request meetings with the ones you like.
steps: In the AI recommendations tab, swipe through suggested companies and mark them relevant or not.
In the All companies tab, narrow results with search, category, and match-rate filters and sorting (relevance, name, booth location).
Tap a company card to view its details.
Tap Request meeting to propose a meeting for a time slot you want.
Bookmark companies you like to collect them in the Favorites tab.
tips: Track the status of your requests in the Meetings screen.

discoverExhibitor.title: Discover companies
discoverExhibitor.intro: Browse visiting buyers and reach out with a meeting request first.
steps: In the AI recommendations tab, swipe through suggested buyers and mark them relevant or not.
In the All companies tab, narrow results with search, interest-area, and match-rate filters and sorting.
Tap a card to view its details.
Tap Request meeting to propose a meeting for a time slot you want.
Bookmark buyers you like to collect them in the Favorites tab.
tips: Fill in your profile's business fields and target contact accurately so buyers can find you.

meetingsBuyer.title: My meetings
meetingsBuyer.intro: See requested and accepted meetings on a day-by-day timeline and respond to them.
steps: Pick a date from the top tabs to see that day's meeting slots. A red dot marks received requests awaiting your reply.
Use the action strip at the top to jump straight to received requests and reviews that need writing.
Select a meeting to see the counterpart, AI match score, time, and venue.
Accept, decline, or cancel from the detail panel. Declining and cancelling ask for a reason.
After a meeting ends, record the outcome with Write review.
tips: Tap an empty time slot to jump to Discover and find a company to fill it.

meetingsExhibitor.title: My meetings
meetingsExhibitor.intro: Respond to received meeting requests and manage confirmed meetings.
steps: Pick a date from the top tabs to see that day's meetings. A red dot marks received requests awaiting your reply.
In the action strip, tap a received request to accept or decline it. Declining asks for a reason.
Select a meeting to see the buyer, AI match score, time, and booth location.
If your schedule changes, use Cancel to free up the slot.
After a meeting ends, record the outcome with Write review.
tips: Marking no-show or attended feeds into the secretariat's tallies.

profileBuyer.title: My profile
profileBuyer.intro: View the business-matching application you submitted (read-only).
steps: Skim the fields to confirm your submitted information is correct.
Empty fields are shown as —.
To change anything, contact the secretariat. You cannot edit it on this screen.
tips: If the secretariat requests changes, the application reopens for editing.

profileExhibitor.title: My profile
profileExhibitor.intro: View the exhibitor profile you submitted (read-only).
steps: Tap the Basic info, Company, Business fields, and Target tabs to review each section.
Empty fields are shown as —.
To change anything, contact the secretariat. You cannot edit it on this screen.
tips: Preferred buyers and availability on the Target tab affect matching accuracy.

applyBuyer.title: Fill in your application
applyBuyer.intro: Complete your buyer business-matching application in three steps.
steps: Work through Basic info → Interests → Review. Use the stepper to jump back to any step you've reached.
Tapping Next validates required fields. If something is missing, it jumps to that field.
Your entries are saved automatically at each step.
The last step's Save and exit takes you to the pre-entry screen; you submit from there.
tips: Filling in the form does not submit it. Tap Submit on the pre-entry screen to file it.

applyExhibitor.title: Fill in your profile
applyExhibitor.intro: Complete your exhibitor business-matching profile in five steps.
steps: Work through Basic info, Business fields, Company, Target contact, and Done in order.
If changes were requested, read the note at the top and fix the flagged items.
Your entries are saved automatically at each step.
On the Done step, check the checklist and use the edit links to fill any missing items.
After saving, submit from the pre-entry screen to file it.
tips: Editing is only possible during the application period and while your status is Registered or Changes requested.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: One place for meeting requests, acceptances, cancellations, reminders, and review alerts.
steps: Use the type chips at the top to filter by kind (request, accepted, cancelled, reminder, review requested, review ready).
Tapping a notification marks it read and jumps to the related meeting.
Tap Mark all read to clear unread notifications at once.
tips: If the list is long, use Load more to keep viewing earlier notifications.

welcome.title: Before you enter
welcome.intro: Shows your application and approval status and the next step to take now.
steps: Read the status card's badge and description to see your current stage (drafting, under review, approved, changes requested, etc.).
During the application period, use Fill in / Edit to complete your application and Submit to file it.
If changes were requested, read the note, fix your application, and submit again.
Once approved and the application period closes, you enter the home screen automatically.
tips: Your account info and Log out are below the status card.

organizerDashboard.title: Operations dashboard
organizerDashboard.intro: An operator overview of the whole event's business-matching and meeting status (aggregated, read-only).
steps: Check total business matches, completed meetings, no-show rate, review completion, and slot utilization in the top metric cards.
A red Zero-meeting companies card means some exhibitors have no meetings. Tap Assign to go to Business-matching assignment.
Use the Registrants / Participants card to compare approved vs. registered participation for exhibitors and buyers.
Read the Meeting status breakdown and Meetings by hour charts to follow upcoming, completed, no-show, and cancelled flows.
tips: The red Zero-meeting companies card and the no-show / review meters are the action-needed signals; the rest is informational.

organizerMembers.title: Member management
organizerMembers.intro: Manage the exhibitor and buyer roster and approve submitted applications.
steps: Switch between the Exhibitors and Buyers tabs and narrow with search, status, and category filters.

In Upload roster, download the template, fill it in, and upload it. Add a common password to make the accounts log-in ready, check the per-row preview, then apply (rows merge by id, so re-uploading won't duplicate).
Use Add member to add one person, and each row's Edit, Deactivate, and Delete to tidy the roster.
Use View application to open a submission and decide Approve, Reject, or Request changes (reject and request-changes require a reason).
Use Export to download the current list as CSV or Excel.
tips: Tap a row to open the company detail, where you can view its profile and meeting schedule and fill empty slots.
Trade-office (sub) accounts see only the buyers they registered and cannot review applications.

organizerForcedMatching.title: Business-matching assignment
organizerForcedMatching.intro: Fill the empty slots in the company × time-slot schedule, manually or in bulk.
steps: Search rows in the Exhibitors / Buyers tabs and narrow with the Has empty slots and Unassigned filters.
Tap an empty cell to pick a counterpart from the companies available for that slot and create a meeting (manual assignment).
To fill just one company, use the ⚡ action on its row to generate a preview, then confirm it.
To fill everything, use Bulk assign all (AI saturation) to build a draft, then review and Confirm or Discard it.
In the bulk settings, adjust meeting length (30 / 60 / 90 min), the assignment time window, and the minimum guaranteed meetings per company.
tips: Past times and slots a participant marked unavailable are never assigned.
After assigning, check that the Zero-meeting companies count drops on the operations dashboard.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.intro: Manage overall operations — events, companies, meetings, interpreters, booths, and more.
steps: Pick the area to manage (events, companies, meetings, etc.) from the left sidebar.
Use the event switcher at the top to choose the event you're working on; tables and metrics follow the selected event.
Manage data with the actions at the top-right of each screen (register, export, etc.).
tips: Write actions are hidden for read-only accounts.

generalBuyer.title: NABI help
generalBuyer.intro: There's no dedicated guide for this screen, so here are the basics.
steps: Use the left sidebar to move between Home, Discover, Meetings, Notifications, and Profile.
Request meetings with the companies you want from Discover.
Respond to received requests and manage your schedule in Meetings.
tips: Need help? Use the secretariat contact at the bottom of the sidebar.

generalExhibitor.title: NABI help
generalExhibitor.intro: There's no dedicated guide for this screen, so here are the basics.
steps: Use the left sidebar to move between Home, Discover, Meetings, Notifications, and Profile.
Accept or decline received meeting requests in Meetings.
Keep your profile and application accurate so buyers can find you.
tips: Need help? Use the secretariat contact at the bottom of the sidebar.

generalOrganizer.title: NABI operator help
generalOrganizer.intro: There's no dedicated guide for this screen, so here are the basics.
steps: Check the whole event's business-matching and meeting status on the operations dashboard.
Tidy the roster and approve applications in Member management.
Fill empty schedules manually or in bulk in Business-matching assignment.
tips: If there are zero-meeting companies, handle them first in Business-matching assignment.
